newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down or extending flat trend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down or extending flat trend.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stay flat for the second consecutive session in the absence of fresh fundamental signals or fall in profit-taking after strong gains earlier in the week, analysts said.
Analysts said March earnings data due later on Friday were likely to move only individual stocks while the whole market was seen in horizontal trend next week.

Traders said construction company Espebepe which rose 31 percent in the last three sessions might continue its growth on hopes that it would succeed in convincing its creditors for a debt restructuring deal. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
